title: measuretwice shared definitions (v0)
description: Shared value definitions for all measuretwice v0 artifact schemas. Resolve references from this directory. The Rust core validates the cross-field invariants that JSON Schema cannot express.

schema_version.description: Artifact schema version. The v0 contracts publish version 1 only.

artifact_id.description: Stable identifier for a definition, check, dataset, split, plan, profile, or evaluator. Lowercase segments separated by single hyphens.

case_id.description: Stable case identifier. Unique inside one dataset.

group_id.description: Identifier for related cases. All cases of one group stay in one dataset split.

input_name.description: Declared input name. Same character rules as a TypeScript property name.

content_hash.description: Canonical content hash. Sixty-four lowercase hexadecimal characters. The hashing contract defines the digest, the hash domain, and the canonical form.

timestamp.description: Date and time in UTC, in RFC 3339 format.

outcome.description: Outcome of one check. Pass meets the acceptance meaning. Fail meets an unacceptable meaning. Review needs a human decision. Error reports an execution or validation failure. Skipped reports that the check was not attempted.

aggregate_outcome.description: Aggregate outcome of one case. Order of severity: fail, then error, then review or skipped, then pass. Skipped checks surface as review in the aggregate.

completion_status.description: Execution status of one run. Independent of the aggregate outcome. A terminal report is immutable.

run_mode.description: Shadow records the outcome next to the existing decision. Enforcement returns a report that the host uses to decide.

qualification_status.description: Qualification of one profile for its declared scope. A qualification flag is not an authenticated approval.

answer_kind.description: Kind of assessed answer. Categorical covers named answers. Binary covers explicit yes and no answers. Ordered covers a descriptive scale.

metric_name.description: Evaluation metric. Every value carries its numerator and denominator. False acceptance rate and error among accepted cases are different quantities.

reason_code.description: Stable reason code from the published registry. Codes keep their meaning across releases.

message.description: Short cause text. Contains no credentials and no raw case content.

field_path.description: JSON Pointer to the rejected field, when the reason is a validation failure.

usage.description: Usage amounts reported by one evaluator execution. The adapter contract lists the supported fields. An absent field was not reported.

value.description: Null when the denominator is zero. A zero denominator produces no value.

artifact_reference.description: Reference to another artifact by stable name and canonical content hash.

profile_reference.description: Reference to one profile by identifier and content hash.
